accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: Read Workforce Advancement Project accessibility commitments, our WCAG 2.1 AA target, known exceptions, and how to report an accessibility barrier.
accessibility.heading: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Workforce Advancement Project works to make this site easier to use for members, partners, employers, and community supporters. We aim to provide clear content, readable layouts, keyboard-usable navigation, and mobile-friendly access on slow devices and limited connections.
accessibility.commitmentCopy1: We target conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA across both the public marketing site and the member portal. That includes meaningful page structure, descriptive link text, keyboard operability, sufficient color contrast, alternative text for informational images, captions or transcripts for prerecorded media we publish, and form fields with associated labels and error messaging that screen readers can announce.
accessibility.commitmentCopy2: We test against this target with automated tooling on every pull request and with periodic manual screen-reader review. Where a third-party component or partner system is embedded in our pages, we work with that provider to surface accessibility issues to them and to substitute components when a fix is not available.
accessibility.exceptionsTitle: Known exceptions we are actively fixing
accessibility.exceptionsCopy: We track every known accessibility gap. The following items are open as of the last reviewed date above and are on our active burn-down list:
accessibility.exception1: A small number of admin-only data tables are rendered as bare HTML tables without full header semantics. These are not member-facing. Tracked in our internal QA queue and being migrated to our standard accessible table component.
accessibility.exception2: One marketing image is missing meaningful alternative text and is currently presented as decorative. Replacement copy is queued for the next content review.
accessibility.exception3: Some AI-generated outputs (resume drafts, interview feedback) may not yet include landmark structure consistent with the rest of the portal. We are adding semantic wrappers to the AI-tool result views.
accessibility.helpTitle: If you need help using this site
accessibility.helpCopy: If you run into a barrier while using WorkforceAP.org — anything that prevents you from completing an application, reading content, or using a tool — please contact us. We will respond within five business days and will do our best to provide the information or support you need in another format while we work on a permanent fix.
accessibility.helpForm: Report an accessibility issue via our contact form
accessibility.improvementsCopy1: We continue improving content clarity, color contrast, tap targets, and responsive behavior across public and member-facing pages. New components ship with an accessibility review checklist; existing surfaces are audited on a rolling basis.
accessibility.improvementsCopy2: If something is hard to read, navigate, or complete, please tell us. That feedback helps us improve access for the people this work is meant to serve.

dashboard.title: Your home base
dashboard.body: Your overview: certification path, application pipeline, weekly study activity and points. Do this next at the top is the one action that moves you forward today; My program in the menu holds your full course list.

aiTools.title: AI Career Tools
aiTools.body: Resume help, cover letters, interview practice and a voice career advisor in one studio. Start with the resume so your applications go out ready.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: Your counselor and the WorkforceAP team write to you here. Unread threads show a badge; reply from the same page.

profile.title: Profile & settings
profile.body: Your name opens Profile & settings: contact details, photo, notifications and language. Keep it current so your counselor and employers can reach you.

program.title: Training progress
program.body: My program is your course list and progress: modules done, what comes next, Coursera and your certificates. Log a certification here once you pass the exam.

jobs.title: Find a job
jobs.body: Job board lists roles matched to your program and skills. Apply in one click and follow every application in Job applications; interviews and offers show on your home pipeline.

help.title: Come back any time
help.body: Help reopens this tour whenever you want it and links to the Member Guide.

offer.title: New here? Take a two-minute tour
offer.body: See where your training progress lives, how to find and apply for jobs, where your messages are and how to update your profile.

overview.title: Your hiring dashboard
overview.body: Active roles, candidates in review and open offers at a glance. Work queue in the menu lists today's actions: candidates to review, interviews to schedule and postings going stale.

applicants.title: Review candidates
applicants.body: Everyone who applied, with program, status and match score. Open a candidate to see training progress and their profile, then move them forward or pass.

pipeline.title: Track your pipeline
pipeline.body: Reviewed, interviewing, offered, hired: one board for every open role. Match history keeps the AI-suggested members for each posting.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: Talk with the WorkforceAP team about a posting, a candidate or an interview. Unread threads show a badge here.

postJob.title: Post a job
postJob.body: Takes about two minutes: title, pay, schedule and the skills you need. Imports pulls roles from your job board or LinkedIn. Qualified program members are matched to every live role automatically.

offer.title: New here? Take a two-minute tour
offer.body: See where to post a job, review candidates, track your pipeline, message the team and manage your company profile.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.body: Your company profile, logo and contact details. Candidates see the company details you set here on every posting.

help.title: Come back any time
help.body: Help reopens this tour whenever you want it and links to How it works, the employer guide.

members.title: Referred members
members.body: Everyone you have referred, with their stage, training progress and last activity. Open a member to see their full journey.

attention.title: Attention queue
attention.body: Members who may need a nudge: stalled applications, inactive learners and at-risk flags, each with the reason and a next step.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: Reach the WorkforceAP team about a referral, a milestone or partner support. Unread threads show a badge here.

referralLink.title: Your referral link
referralLink.body: Share this link or code with the people you serve. Anyone who applies through it is tracked back to your organization from application to placement.

offer.title: New here? Take a two-minute tour
offer.body: See where your referral link lives, how to follow referred members, where payouts and exports are and how to reach the team.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.body: Referral partners earn a payout for each verified placement. Connect a bank account here once; payouts are sent when a placement is verified.

exports.title: Exports
exports.body: Download your referred members, milestones and outcomes as CSV for grant reports and board updates. Outcomes snapshot shows the same numbers on screen.

help.title: Come back any time
help.body: Help reopens this tour whenever you want it and links to the Referral guide.

offer.title: New here? Take a two-minute tour
offer.body: See what needs attention today, how to open a member, how to message them and where notes live.

attention.title: What needs attention today
attention.body: Three numbers, one rule each: members flagged urgent or watch, replies you owe after 24 hours, and everyone on track. Today only lists people who need you.

queue.title: One list, each member once
queue.body: Members are grouped by the kind of contact they need — at risk, reply owed, gone quiet, follow-ups, new, celebrate — and every row says why. Urgent rows sort first.

openMember.title: Open a member
openMember.body: Use View member on any row, or All members for the full roster. The roster stat cards say why a member needs attention and each card links to the page that acts on it.

memberRecord.title: The member record
memberRecord.body: Each member opens on four tabs: Profile, Training, Notes and Messages. Notes live on the Notes tab — counselor notes and session notes — and the Message action sits at the top of the page.

atRisk.title: At-risk members
atRisk.body: The risk model ranks your caseload by inactivity, stalled training and unanswered messages. Start here on a busy day.

messages.title: Message a member
messages.body: Messages holds every conversation with your members. Open thread on a Today row takes you straight to the person who is waiting.

help.title: Come back any time
help.body: Help reopens this tour whenever you want it and links to the portal guide.

commandCenter.body: Your home base. Active Students, Placements YTD and who needs attention sit at the top, then What needs you today: replies owed, applications and certifications awaiting review, interview prep. Every row links to the page that acts on it.

overview.body: The full picture behind the Command Center: total members, assessments completed, who is active in training, programs enrolled and completed, plus recent signups and placements. Come here for the numbers, not just the queue.

students.title: Students
students.body: Every student in one roster: status, program and who needs attention. Open a student for the full record or export the list. Training progress is the same roster sorted by training.

messages.body: Every conversation members, employers and partners are having with staff. The badge counts messages still waiting on a reply, so someone looks today.

programs.title: Programs
programs.body: The training programs you offer, one card per program with learners enrolled and completion. Program requests, students asking to switch, sit right below it.

trainingProgress.title: Training progress
trainingProgress.body: Course-by-course progress for every enrolled student, sortable, across the curriculum and Coursera. Assessments and Certificates open right under it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Organization settings sit at the bottom of the rail under Security & system, with Users, Audit logs and Exports; Feature flags open under Settings. Most days you will not need this section.
